Dear CXG Team,

I am writing to apply for the Freelance Luxury Brand Evaluator position. As a discerning customer of premium and luxury brands, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to the enhancement of customer experiences for some of the world's most prestigious brands.

My professional background as a junior digital marketer has equipped me with a keen eye for detail and a systematic approach to evaluation. In my role at Episto, I conduct on-page SEO audits, analyze performance data, and ensure that every aspect of a website meets high standards. This experience has trained me to observe nuances, identify areas for improvement, and provide objective, actionable feedback—skills that are directly transferable to evaluating luxury brand experiences.

I am particularly drawn to the mission-based nature of this role, which allows me to choose assignments that align with my interests. I am an existing customer of luxury brands across fashion, watches, and cosmetics, and I understand the expectations that come with premium service. I am confident in my ability to provide honest, insightful feedback that can help shape brand strategies.

I am not contractually engaged with any retail brands, ensuring the integrity and objectivity of my evaluations. I am punctual, organized, and reliable, with a passion for customer experience. I am also comfortable with both in-store and online evaluations, and I am eager to complete the certification process and begin contributing.

I have registered on live.cxg.com and look forward to the next steps. Thank you for considering my application. I am enthusiastic about the possibility of joining your global community of evaluators and making a meaningful impact on the luxury market.

Sincerely,
